many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def dist_to_frame_border(r, c, fi):
    """Manhattan distance from (r,c) to the closest point on frame border."""
    l, t, r2, b = fi["left"], fi["top"], fi["right"], fi["bottom"]
    
    # Distance to closest point on the rectangle border
    # If in same row band, distance is horizontal to left/right edge
    if t <= r <= b:
        if c < l: return l - c
        elif c > r2: return c - r2
        else:
            # Cross row - must go to row boundary
            # Closest is min distance to top row (t) or bottom row (b) at column c
            return min(abs(t - r), abs(b - r))
    elif r < t:
        # Above frame - closest is top-left corner of column range
        # or somewhere above where column is in range
        if l <= c <= r2:
            return t - r  # Same column band, just above
        else:
            # Not in col band - must go to corner

            return (t - r) + dist_to_col
    else:  # r > b
